text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"Assesses how strongly the applicant's formal education matches or exceeds the role's stated academic qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant bachelor's degree, meeting the minimum but not the preferred academic qualification."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant bachelor's degree plus clear advanced study short of a completed master's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant master's degree in a technical field relevant to the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant master's degree with especially advanced or research-oriented technical preparation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a relevant doctoral degree in a technical field relevant to the role."}]},{"name":"Professional experience depth","description":"Assesses the overall depth of the applicant's professional software-engineering experience relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only the minimum level of professional software-engineering experience for the role, with little sign of growth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of relevant product work and basic credibility in testing, maintaining, or launching software."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience, typically around four to five years or equivalent sustained product work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong experience, typically around five to six years, with some indication of increasing responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive experience, typically around seven or more years, with clear maturation from maintenance or testing into broader engineering ownership."}]},{"name":"Production systems ownership","description":"Assesses how much full-lifecycle responsibility the letter claims for testing, maintaining, launching, and operating production services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions production work but gives limited scope or unclear ownership beyond participation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims full-lifecycle work on a small number of services, suggesting narrow production breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows moderate breadth across several production services or repeated launches."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows broad ownership across multiple services with clear attention to maintenance, launch, and reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated full-lifecycle ownership across many production services, indicating substantial production depth."}]},{"name":"Role-specific understanding","description":"Assesses how precisely the letter shows understanding of this specific Google Information Security Engineering role and its mission.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could be sent to almost any software job, with little evidence the writer understands this team's specific mission or responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References one clearly relevant theme such as security, backend work, or automation, but the fit remains broad and lightly tailored."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the application to several role elements such as foundational tooling, vulnerability response, or AI agents, though mostly in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly links past work and interests to multiple responsibilities in this exact role and explains why this team is a strong fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of Google's platform-security context and explains this role's leverage at scale in a way that feels unusually targeted."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"Assesses how well the letter articulates automation as a way to scale security work, reduce manual triage, and improve lifecycle security.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little or nothing about automation as a security problem or capacity lever."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation generically without explaining how it changes security workflows or expert throughput."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that automation can reduce manual security work or speed up vulnerability handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains automation as a way to scale scarce security expertise across teams or across the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames security automation as a systems-design problem and discusses mechanisms such as triage, variant analysis, bounded agents, or workload multiplication."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"Assesses the extent to which the letter frames security tooling as making the secure path easier for downstream developers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses on building tools with no real indication of care for the engineers who must use them."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams in generic terms but does not explain how secure behavior becomes easier."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Notes reducing toil, helping busy engineers, or making security easier to follow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes secure defaults, downstream usability, or respect for the people building on the tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly shows empathy for developer users and treats usability, interface discipline, or default-safe behavior as central to security adoption."}]},{"name":"Go experience depth","description":"Assesses the depth and centrality of Go in the applicant's production engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists Go among languages but does not show that it is central to the applicant's real work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates regular Go use but gives limited evidence of primary backend ownership in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes Go a main language for meaningful production work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated backend design and implementation in Go across multiple services or years."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as the clear core language behind substantial, role-relevant production ownership and system design."}]},{"name":"Python experience depth","description":"Assesses the depth and quality of Python use for services, automation, analysis, or tooling relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or implies only minimal scripting familiarity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python generally but gives little sense of production-quality use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for tooling, automation, analysis, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a production-grade language used for maintained services or internal systems others rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep Python ownership directly relevant to the role, such as robust automation platforms, analysis tooling, or agent implementations."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"Assesses experience designing systems with agents and the surrounding control infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or agent-like systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation vaguely without enough detail to judge architecture."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent-like workflows or pipelines with named components or languages."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains an end-to-end agentic architecture with clear separation between agents and control infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature design of bounded agentic systems with explicit contracts, permissions, logging, guardrails, or auditability."}]},{"name":"Applied AI engineering","description":"Assesses the relevance and maturity of the applicant's experience shipping AI or LLM-powered functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any AI or LLM work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or light exposure without shipped engineering work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes shipping AI or LLM-backed functionality but gives limited detail on reliability or operating considerations."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience with explicit attention to evaluation, trustworthiness, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial AI delivery directly relevant to secure automation or agents, with clear reliability, evaluation, or hardening practices."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability handling automation","description":"Assesses experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, prioritization, deduplication, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention automating vulnerability intake, triage, or related workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Alludes to security automation but not specifically to vulnerability-handling processes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience automating vulnerability triage or intake at a high level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage functions such as classification, routing, prioritization, or deduplication."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline that materially reduced manual work and explains how it operated."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Assesses the depth and specificity of the applicant's security review and assessment experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest or review activity without concrete assessment methods."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States having performed security assessments or reviews in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies concrete assessment methods such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface mapping, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a substantial engineering practice, showing structured evaluation and follow-through on findings or fixes."}]},{"name":"Data structures and algorithms fluency","description":"Assesses whether the letter demonstrates practical algorithmic thinking applied to real engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of algorithmic or data-structure thinking."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims general strength in algorithms or data structures but offers no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of using a better structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong example tied to meaningful gains in performance, tractability, or reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking feel like a core strength through especially clear or high-impact examples of changing a hard problem materially."}]},{"name":"Supplemental security practice","description":"Assesses evidence of security depth beyond ordinary product engineering, such as certifications, CTFs, or other hands-on practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no security credential, competition, or hands-on practice beyond day-to-day engineering work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light self-study or informal exposure to security practice without a strong external signal."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows one moderate signal such as a foundational certification or recurring CTF participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong hands-on signal such as OSCP, serious CTF participation, or equivalent practical practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals or unusually credible hands-on results, such as advanced certification plus notable competition performance."}]},{"name":"Open-source contribution depth","description":"Assesses the extent of external code contribution or maintenance work that signals interface discipline and engineering maturity.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions very light upstream engagement, such as an occasional fix or patch."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring contribution to outside projects or ownership of a small public library."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained maintenance or regular contribution to a project used beyond the applicant's immediate team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates real stewardship through outside users, contribution review, release management, and ongoing responsibility for a project."}]},{"name":"Independent project rigor","description":"Assesses the technical ambition and execution quality of personal engineering projects described in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention a personal project, or describes one too vaguely to judge."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small utility or simple app with limited technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a modest but completed side project that demonstrates follow-through more than depth."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial personal system with nontrivial engineering concerns such as replication, recovery, or distributed coordination."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes an ambitious, technically demanding independent system pursued in depth and framed with production-quality rigor."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity and outcomes","description":"Assesses how concretely the letter supports its claims with specific implementations, examples, and results.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic claims about being qualified or interested, with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides some specifics such as years, languages, or job titles but few illustrative achievements or outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes several concrete examples of work, though the resulting impact is only lightly described."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Supports most major claims with specific implementations and makes the resulting impact reasonably clear."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with concrete mechanics and clear outcomes, often showing what changed or why the work mattered."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"Assesses how clearly the letter forms a unified, easy-to-follow case rather than a disconnected list of qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads like a disconnected list of qualifications with little through-line."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but feels mostly templated or choppy in how it connects motivation, experience, and fit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is easy to follow and links background to the role in a conventional way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a clear, cohesive arc that connects past work, present strengths, and this role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels unusually unified and purposeful, using a memorable opening idea or career through-line that is reinforced throughout."}]},{"name":"Proofreading accuracy","description":"Assesses the extent to which spelling, grammar, and wording errors distract from the application.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, typing, or wording errors that repeatedly distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has numerous visible errors but remains generally understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a noticeable but moderate number of mechanical errors that a reader can still read past."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Has only a few minor mechanical errors."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially clean, with polished spelling, grammar, and word choice throughout."}]}]}
